decodedCinema.limits: Decoded RGB luminance/edge measurements, not OCR, optical flow, foreground segmentation, semantic understanding or audience evaluation. Text and image share full-frame novelty. Missing domains remain unmeasured.

climaxEvidence.source: decoded final MP4 luminance layout; camera and text not separated

beatIntent.source: selected salient beats versus decoded MP4 local luma peaks

outputProfile.source: explicit V3 purpose / actual aspect / opt-in loop requirement

holdMotion.source: decoded HOLD only; 400 ms entry and 200 ms exit excluded
holdMotion.limits: HOLD score uses local block-flow median/p25, camera coherence and a provisional luma component; verified primary-mask motion replaces that component after decode. Camera coherence is a pixel estimate, not recovered 3D movement.

endingClosure.source: decoded final frame + decoded AAC track duration + authoritative lyric intervals
endingClosure.limits: Endpoint and interval closure only; no claim of vocal separation, lyric semantic completion or artistic release. Source audio is never altered.

regionalPerceptualEvidence.source: decoded full-frame spatial luma grid; preceding six shots
regionalPerceptualEvidence.limits: Includes text and camera; no subject recognition, segmentation or conceptual novelty

semanticDirection.limits: Local structural roles are not semantic validation; artistic certification remains unavailable

foregroundNovelty.limits: Regional luma variation is not segmented subject novelty and never fills foregroundNovelty
